# Durable host (Render)

This repo includes `render.yaml` + `Dockerfile` for a single-service deploy
(API + web + SQLite volume).

## Deploy (one-time)

1. Open: https://render.com/deploy?repo=https://github.com/selvera247/agent  
   (or New → Blueprint → connect `selvera247/agent`)
2. Approve the free web service `findatagraph`
3. After deploy, copy the public URL (e.g. `https://findatagraph.onrender.com`)
4. Paste that URL into the portfolio Launch demo button  
   (`demo-interview--app` → FinDataGraph case study)

## Demo login

- `controller@findatagraph.demo` / `password123`

## Notes

- Free Render dynos sleep after idle; first request may take ~30–60s
- JWT secret is auto-generated by the blueprint
- Disk mount persists SQLite across deploys
